contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN MAGNENTIVS PF AVG] ; R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bare headed bust draped right. Obverse inscription: [DN MAGNENTIVS PF AVG]. Reverse description: Emperor riding right spearing barbarian. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 22.7mm, Weight: 4.47gms, die axis: 6
